Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What

Print "lose X mana next turn" / "you have X less mana next turn" as one keyword, **Overload (X)**: a §6.3 verb for the next-turn rider that already exists (`next_turn_mana` of −X, R1848004). **Wording only**: no script, number or rule changes, and `cargo jackioh classify` should read it as wording-only, a micro patch.

## The cards

| Card | New text |
|---|---|
| Core #2 Speciesist (both faces) | Cry: … Overload ({mana}). |
| Core #21 Hinder | Cast on draw: Overload your opponent ({mana}). (base face keeps its discard) |
| M #18 Expedition12 | Overload ({loss}). Make a card in your hand Radiant. |
| M #19 Expedition123 | Overload ({loss}), then ({lossAfter}) the turn after. … |
| M #22.1 Fortify Mind | Greed: Overload ({mana}). Discard … |
| M #82 Medina Outfitter | Cry: Buff every card in your hand … Overload ({mana}). |
| M #89 Jlarna | Aura: Credit line {credit}: spend up to {credit} mana you don't have. Repay it as Overload over your next {instalments\|turn\|turns}. |
| S #117 Core System, S #118 Secure System | … Overload ({loss}). |
| TG #52 Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control | Steal an enemy Unit. Overload ({loss}). |
| S+ #56 Impact Reactor | Cry: Overload ({mana}), then ({mana2}) the turn after. … |
| S+ #72 Foreshadow | When an enemy Unit is summoned, attack it and Overload ({mana}). |

Not Overload, left alone: S+ #82 Endless Expedition and S+ #95 JC Backed (a loss for the rest of the game), and the cards that *gain* mana next turn.

## Rules to write down (§6.3 row "Overload X", after Mana / gain mana)

- `next_turn_mana { amount: -X }` on the card's controller, or on their opponent for "Overload your opponent (X)". It is summed with the other riders, floored at 0 by the refresh, and shown as the existing badge (R169).
- Unlike Hearthstone's Overload, which is paid on the play, it is **paid where the text puts it**: as a Spell resolves, as a Cry runs, as a trigger fires. So a countered Spell, or a Cry that never runs, pays nothing, the same as today.
- "Overload (X), then (Y) the turn after" sets the second rider at the start of the next turn, which Expedition123 and Impact Reactor already do.
- Jlarna's instalments stay in their own ledger (R1224). Each one is taken off a refresh as an Overload is, so the word describes them without changing the credit line.

Since this issue now has a number, add a ruling note (R<this issue>000) recording the decision, with a proving test, instead of the bare §6.3 row that the reference branch used.
